name: Confession of the Golden Witch
source:
It is not advised to read this without completing Umineko no Naku Koro Ni Chiru.

[spoiler]Confession of the Golden Witch is a manga-only arc contained within the Twilight of the Golden Witch manga. It follows the life of Sayo Yasuda and the days leading up to the Rokkenjima massacre. Confession is also the only story wherein Sayo directly appears without any form of disguise. [Wikipedia]

This fan-adaptation of the manga chapters in a VN medium contains multiple stories: Confession of the Golden Witch, Abuse of Power, The Cage of Obligations, When the Seagulls Cry.[/spoiler]
translation:
不建议在未完成Umineko no Naku Koro Ni Chiru之前阅读本文。

[spoiler]《黄金魔女的告白》是漫画《黄金魔女的黄昏》中包含的纯漫画篇。它讲述了安田沙代的一生以及六间岛大屠杀之前的日子。《告白》也是唯一一个佐代不加任何伪装直接出现的故事。[Wikipedia]这部VN媒体漫画章节的粉丝改编包含多个故事：《金魔女的告白》、《滥用权力》、《义务之笼》、《海鸥哭泣时》。[/spoiler]
